rules.sentence: Dyskeratosis and acantholysis on histopathology characterize Darier disease.[18]
The skin manifestations of Darier disease consist of red or brown hyperkeratotic papules and plaques.[19]
These lesions develop in seborrheic and intertriginous areas.[1]
The condition commonly starts on the upper trunk or neck.[20]
Sun exposure, friction, heat, and sweat can exacerbate the disease.[1]
